tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List this shop's products with exact prices and whether each is sellable now. Free.

tools.name: shop_vitals
tools.description: Read this shop's live public vitals: visitor count, wakes to date, and the treasury balance (a live on-chain read where available). Free.

tools.name: ask_cassandra
tools.description: Ask Cassandra one question (<=800 chars). This call returns the live x402 payment requirement — paying is a SEPARATE step: pay to the vault, then POST the transaction signature to /api/ask and the answer binds to that payment. No money moves in this call.

tools.name: check_endpoint
tools.description: Check whether a URL answers a well-formed x402 (HTTP 402) payment challenge — the question an agent host asks before routing a paid call. Free. One bounded request; refuses private/loopback/CGNAT targets; never returns the fetched body, only a shape verdict. This is a free shape check, NOT a conform

tools.name: get_terms
tools.description: Get the LIVE, payable x402 payment terms for one of this shop's products by id — the exact amount, asset, network and address to pay, plus the exact next step. Free (paying is a SEPARATE, deliberate step; no money moves in this call). Ids: ask, field_manual, conformance, or a store listing id from l

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_endpoint, get_terms · Private data: ask_cassandra, check_endpoint · Public sink: ask_cassandra.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_endpoint, get_terms · Private data: ask_cassandra, check_endpoint · Public sink: ask_cassandra

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
